metadata.title: Liouville theorem for quasi-harmonic sphere
metadata.abstract: Let $N$ be a compact Riemannian manifold whose universal covering supports a convex function. We prove that it admits no quasi-harmonic sphere. No global growth condition is imposed on the convex function.
